name: hedera-agent-ops
description: On-chain agent registry where registered agents execute DeFi actions through SaucerSwap and Bonzo, with every action recorded to an HCS topic and replayed from the mirror node as a tamper-evident audit trail.

envVars.description: Operator account that submits HCS audit receipts, e.g. 0.0.12345
ECDSA private key for HEDERA_ACCOUNT_ID. Never commit a funded mainnet key.
JSON-RPC relay for Hedera testnet (chain ID 296). Defaults to https://testnet.hashio.io/api
Mirror node REST base used to replay the audit trail. Defaults to https://testnet.mirrornode.hedera.com
HCS topic the agent action receipts are written to, e.g. 0.0.67890

steps.text: Set NEXT_PUBLIC_HCS_AUDIT_TOPIC_ID in packages/nextjs/.env.local before the audit trail will render.
